entries.title: Factoring a sinusoid into phasor form
entries.description: separate $Ae^{j(\omega t+\phi)}$ into a fixed phasor $Ae^{j\phi}$ and a rotating factor $e^{j\omega t}$.

entries.title: Defining and interpreting a phasor
entries.description: treat $V=Ae^{j\phi}$ as a stationary complex quantity that carries amplitude and phase.

entries.title: Linking frequency sign to rotation direction
entries.description: determine whether a complex exponential rotates clockwise or counterclockwise from the sign of $\omega$.

entries.title: Rewriting sine and cosine with exponentials
entries.description: use Euler identities to convert sine and cosine into sums or differences of exponentials.

entries.title: Interpreting cosine as frequency components
entries.description: recognize a real cosine as two counter-rotating exponentials with frequencies $+\omega$ and $-\omega$.
